1 second silence at start
(...Please. If it's alright for me to lean on you, I want you to accept this.)
—Please wait!

That's why... even if you aren't asking for it,
I still want to tell you.
What?!

...Yes. Please,
let me accept your feelings.

...Yes, I will win. It's a promise.
No matter what happens... I will definitely make a miracle happen.

...And yet, you truly gave it your all just like you said.
What brought this on so suddenly?

Still... ahaha. I'm already depending on you
more than enough as it is, you know, Trainer?

Even if I tell her to run without minding me, she'll likely just
reply with "I'm alright." —In that case...

Since this match... was my win,
...will you grant my wish?
You'll run with me, then?
(—Someday, to this person who is kind enough to make me want to cry...)

K.S. Miracle adjusts her speed to match my pace.
At this rate, it won't serve as any training at all.
...Wait, Trainer?!

Declaring that it was a serious contest, I picked up speed as fast as I could.
—The result was...

Honestly... I had a lot of fun, though.
I never thought I'd get to run alongside you like this, Trainer.

At K.S. Miracle's request, we shortened the daytime training
and decided to resume training again in the evening.

The stars are so beautiful, and the sound of the waves is even more soothing than during the day...
Running out here feels wonderful!
(...It's a miracle that you gave to me.)
Watching her like that, I somehow felt—
Trainer...

...That is because you are kind, Trainer.
Almost far too kind.
Saying I want to run at a time like this at night... It's rather selfish, isn't it?

Rather than receiving a "thank you," I want to share the joy of that moment
when K.S. Miracle can tell the people dear to her, "I was able to deliver it."

It's rare for K.S. Miracle to make a joke like that.
I can tell she's genuinely enjoying her run along the nighttime beach.

...So, I have one request.
If it's not too much trouble—
(Precisely because it's you, there are words I want you to hear.)

Perhaps worn out from running, I conveyed my true thoughts straightforwardly without hiding them.
That she could lean on me, that she was allowed to depend on me—
Eh?

—Trainer.
Today is the final day of our training camp, isn't it?

It's amazing how completely different it feels between morning and night.
...It's magical.
("The time we've spent continuing to run and sharing together is...")

Those earnest eyes remain unchanged from the day we first met.
Having heard all that, anyone would nod in agreement. In that case—

Fufu. If you weren't here, Trainer,
I might really start to think I'd gotten lost.

As she says "I'm off" and starts running, rather than just
watching her back from afar—
Even though we're in the exact same place, it feels like I've arrived somewhere brand new.
...I can hardly wait for the day I get to tell you.

I'm going to run one more lap.
Next time, even if I pick up the pace a bit more—

("Not just 'I'm fine' or 'thank you'...
...More than that.)

I caught up with you. But as expected of you, Trainer.
Your running form is so beautiful—it's very educational.
I start running ahead of K.S. Miracle.
Trainer...

...When I win a GⅠ, you'll be right there beside me.
When that time comes, please listen to these feelings of mine.
Haa, haa, haah... Aha, hahaha.
"I want to try running at night."
A-Are you... alright?
("Thank you for giving me a future.")
